tools.name: singapore_lookup_dataset
tools.description: Resolve an exact dataset ID in the bundled snapshot. No network; a missing entry may exist in the live catalog.

tools.name: singapore_list_collections
tools.description: List a live page of data.gov.sg collections and their child dataset IDs. Page size is controlled by the provider.

tools.name: singapore_search_catalog
tools.description: Search the bundled full data.gov.sg catalog by English keywords, agency and format. No network needed. Results include snapshot date. Use inspect_dataset then query_dataset; non-tabular datasets may require download. Use list_catalog_page for updates since the snapshot.

tools.name: singapore_list_catalog_page
tools.description: List a current live page of data.gov.sg catalog (upstream page size). Use search_catalog for fast search of the bundled snapshot.

tools.name: singapore_inspect_dataset
tools.description: Get live dataset metadata, schema, format, coverage and last update. Field IDs may be internal: use columnMetadata.map/metaMapping names for datastore filters.

tools.name: singapore_query_dataset
tools.description: Query any tabular data.gov.sg dataset. Exact filters, column text search, projection, sorting and pagination. Preserve upstream values/units; no SQL. Non-tabular or unsupported datasets can be downloaded instead.

filters.description: Exact equality by field name, e.g. {"town":"ANG MO KIO"}

sort.description: e.g. month desc, resale_price desc; inspect fields first

tools.name: singapore_get_collection
tools.description: Get a collection and its child dataset metadata to discover related historical series or ACRA partitions.

tools.name: singapore_download_dataset
tools.description: Start or poll a dataset export. Call initiate once, then poll on later calls. Returns provider download URL (may expire), never downloads large files into the conversation. Suitable for CSV/GeoJSON/KML and datasets without datastore support.

tools.name: singapore_catalog_summary
tools.description: List dataset counts by publishing agency and file format, with catalog snapshot date.

tools.name: singapore_list_curated_datasets
tools.description: Browse curated datasets and tool names by topic. Includes coverage dates: some series are historical. The full catalog is searchable separately.

tools.name: singapore_list_weather_stations
tools.description: Discover weather stations, IDs and WGS84 coordinates by observed measure; search by ID/name. No observations omitted from a claimed national inventory.

tools.name: singapore_get_taxi_availability
tools.description: Available taxi coordinates from data.gov.sg, optionally within a radius sorted by distance. Latest unless date_time supplied. Coordinates use WGS84; returns a bounded sample and total match count.

date_time.description: Singapore local time UTC+08:00: YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss

tools.name: singapore_get_carpark_availability
tools.description: HDB/URA carpark live available lots by carpark number. Does not include coordinates: join with carpark directory to locate carparks.

date_time.description: Singapore local time UTC+08:00: YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss

tools.name: singapore_get_traffic_images
tools.description: Traffic camera image URLs, coordinates and timestamps. Optional radius filter. Image URLs are returned, never fetched by this server.

date_time.description: Singapore local time UTC+08:00: YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss

tools.name: singapore_get_bus_arrivals
tools.description: Live next buses at a bus stop, estimated arrival, load and accessibility. Requires LTA_ACCOUNT_KEY. Bus stop codes retain leading zeros.

tools.name: singapore_query_lta
tools.description: LTA lists and alerts. Requires LTA_ACCOUNT_KEY. Stop/service filters are allowed only on provider endpoints supporting them. Offsets apply only to paginated datasets.

tools.name: singapore_find_nearby_bus_stops
tools.description: Search a bounded set of LTA bus-stop pages near WGS84 coordinates. Requires LTA_ACCOUNT_KEY. Complete is true only after an upstream short page; continuation identifies the next unscanned page.

tools.name: singapore_search_statistics
tools.description: Search SingStat Table Builder across all official economic, population, labour, trade, health and social tables. Returns resource IDs to use with inspect_statistics/get_statistics. Use English terms.

tools.name: singapore_inspect_statistics
tools.description: Get SingStat table metadata, frequency, units, definitions, notes, series and coverage before reading observations.

tools.name: singapore_get_statistics
tools.description: Read SingStat time series, retaining unit and footnotes. Fetches table (or one exact upstream period), then filters series locally and keeps the last N upstream periods per series. Values remain strings to preserve missing-value markers. Use series_offset to paginate series.

period.description: Exact upstream period, e.g. 2024; inspect table frequency first

tools.name: singapore_convert_coordinates
tools.description: Convert SVY21 easting/northing metres to WGS84 longitude/latitude or the reverse within Singapore. Uses SLA projection parameters; no API key.

tools.name: singapore_search_address
tools.description: OneMap official address/building/postal-code geocoding (WGS84 plus SVY21). Requires ONEMAP_TOKEN. Search pages are provider pages, usually 10 results.

tools.name: singapore_reverse_geocode
tools.description: OneMap reverse geocoding of Singapore WGS84 coordinates to nearby addresses. Requires ONEMAP_TOKEN.

tools.name: singapore_list_indicators
tools.description: Curated World Bank indicators for Singapore. Other valid indicator codes work with get_indicator.

tools.name: singapore_get_indicator
tools.description: World Bank historical indicator for Singapore, optionally comparing up to five ISO3 countries. Latest years first; null values are preserved. Definitions and publication lag can differ from SingStat. No key required.

indicator.description: Curated alias (e.g. gdp) or World Bank code

tools.name: singapore_get_capabilities
tools.description: Local configuration and source availability. Reports only whether credentials are configured, never their values. No network requests.

tools.name: singapore_get_sources
tools.description: List connected official data sources, documentation and API key requirements. This server reads public information; no account mutation tools.

tools.name: singapore_find_relevant_tools
tools.description: Route a question in French or English to tools and datasets. Deterministic keyword matching; suggestions are not evidence or computed facts. Search catalog with English keywords.

tools.name: singapore_search_acra
tools.description: Search one detailed ACRA partition by entity name or UEN. Select A-Z or Others explicitly; no automatic scan of all partitions. Inspect returned schema for provider field names.

tools.name: singapore_find_nearby_facilities
tools.description: Find nearby HDB carparks with live availability, hawker centres, preschools, park facilities or sport facilities. Reads a bounded full official export (64 MiB max). Only Point geometries with validated WGS84 coordinates are considered; omitted geometries are counted. No arbitrary download URL input.

tools.name: singapore_compare_hdb_prices
tools.description: Compare HDB resale prices across towns and a bounded month interval using the entire official CSV export (64 MiB maximum). Does not extrapolate from a Datastore page. Exports may still be processing: retry on EXPORT_PENDING.
